T1.texte: i rated my week without reels, day by day

en: you skip intros, speed up videos, skim paragraphs,
T2.fr: tu zappes les intros, [[tu mets en x2]], tu survoles, tu sautes des chapitres
T2.texte: my thumb opened instagram [[on its own]] 20 times before lunch, looking for reels

T3.fr: t'apprends à ton cerveau que dès que c'est un peu lent, faut fuir
T3.texte: every queue and every boring moment felt [[ten times longer]] than usual

T4.fr: alors bosser devient insupportable, y'a [[pas de bouton « avancer de 10 s »]]
T4.texte: i almost gave up by 4pm, then left my phone in the kitchen and went to bed early

en: everyone stops to listen when someone can
T2.fr: tout le monde écoute quand quelqu'un [[sait vraiment jouer]]
T2.texte: my violin had been sitting in its case for [[two whole years]]

T3.fr: piano, guitare, batterie, peu importe. tu vas [[galérer pendant des mois]], et la plupart abandonnent
T3.texte: the first 20 minutes sounded awful. then my fingers remembered, and [[i forgot the time]]

en: so when you can play, it shows patience and a passion
of your own, and that's really attractive
T4.fr: alors quand tu sais jouer, ça montre [[ta patience]] et [[une vraie passion à toi]], et ça c'est [[ultra attirant]]
T4.texte: i reached for my phone twice, but there was nothing to fall into, so i kept playing. [[better than monday]]

en: maybe the next tiktok will finally
T2.fr: le [[prochain tiktok]] va [[enfin]] régler tes problèmes, qui sait
T2.texte: the urge to scroll came back hard on my lunch break

en: your brain a chance to get
T3.fr: limite pas ton temps d'écran, commence surtout pas à [[lire]], laisse jamais ton cerveau [[s'ennuyer]]
T3.texte: before, that break was 40 min of reels. today instagram had no reels, just my messages and stories

en: until it knows what you want
T4.fr: continue de [[nourrir l'algo]] jusqu'à ce qu'il sache ce que tu veux [[mieux que toi]]
T4.texte: so i ate slowly, texted a friend back and [[actually rested]] for the first time this week

T5.texte: the reels tab is gone with [[the UnSwipe app]]

en: I KNOW everyone says this, but it's true. the gym,
running, pilates, whatever you'll stick to
T2.fr: JE SAIS, tout le monde le dit, mais c'est vrai. la salle, la course, le pilates, [[ce que tu tiendras sur la durée]]
T2.texte: the hour i used to lose on the couch scrolling became [[a real workout]] on my bedroom floor

T3.fr: c'est [[prouvé]] : le sport booste ton [[moral et ta confiance]], pas juste ton physique
T3.texte: the evenings feel longer now, and that night [[i slept like a rock]]

en: you have more energy, more confidence, and
that is what makes you attractive
T4.fr: t'as plus d'énergie, [[plus confiance en toi]], et [[c'est exactement ça qui attire]]
T4.texte: i didn't think about my phone a single time, which [[never happens]] on a friday night

en: like, but it rarely makes you
T2.fr: être d'accord avec tout le monde, ça te rend sympa, mais [[rarement mémorable]]
T2.texte: instead of watching other people's weekends, i called a friend and we went out for dinner

T3.fr: fais-toi ton avis, explique pourquoi tu le penses, et [[sache contredire sans te braquer]]
T3.texte: we talked for three hours and [[i never once checked my phone]]. i forgot it was even in my bag

en: charisma comes from having a personality people can
T4.fr: le charisme, c'est avoir une personnalité que les gens [[arrivent à cerner]]
T4.texte: overall: [[not a perfect week, but i'm 100% doing it again next week]]
